While working undercover as a salvager at the [[Colossus]], the pirate [[Synara San]] owned a specialized '''salvaging skiff'''. She used the craft to go on salvaging missions in the waters around the Colossus.<ref name="Databank" /> Prior to the [[Bibo incident]], San took [[Resistance]] [[pilot]] and [[spy]] [[Kazuda Xiono]] on a ride aboard her skiff to question him. However, they were interrupted by the appearance of [[Bibo]]'s [[Bibo's mother|mother]], a giant [[rokkna]] sea monster. The two managed to flee aboard the skiff back to the [[Colossus]] and raise the alarm.<ref name="Bibo">{{Resistance|Bibo (episode)}}</ref>
